info.title: QuickPrompt NOVA local API
info.description: Loopback only. No CORS. Mutations require X-QuickPrompt-Client: nova-v1. JSON schemas describe the new HTTP boundary; legacy Archive v1/v2 compatibility is validated by the existing store.

post.summary: Start one finite Qwen3 visual run in the original React document. SAME_TAB requires an ephemeral X-Nova-Surface capability (32-128 characters); BROWSER is disabled unless explicit QA configuration. Same RunId never replays effects.

parameters.name: X-Nova-Surface
parameters.description: Ephemeral capability of the requesting document, kept only in memory. Never model input or persisted activity.

200.description: Start one finite Qwen3 visual run in the original React document. SAME_TAB requires an ephemeral X-Nova-Surface capability (32-128 characters); BROWSER is disabled unless explicit QA configuration. Same RunId never replays effects.

inputNames.description: Explicit user field selection for CREATE_DRAFT or PROPOSE_ADAPTATION. Null/absent asks for definition before authoring. Empty means no new inputs; existing source inputs are retained. These are names, never values or write approval.

contentReview.description: Original material and exact-content review. Model interpretation cannot approve content; case values are masked. Saved and working snapshots remain distinct and private to their authorized user.

purpose.description: CONTENT_ONLY reviews proposed content before another requested effect; it never grants persistence and cannot be committed.

start.description: UTF-16 offset in the original source.

literalChanges.description: Host-computed literal differences from saved and working snapshots. Conservative textual checks are not exhaustive semantic coverage. Every listed ID requires acknowledgement.

approvedLiteralChangeIds.description: Exact set of IDs individually acknowledged in contentReview.literalChanges.entries. Unknown, duplicated, missing or stale IDs are rejected.

sourceChoices.description: Read-only candidates offered for explicit selection after an ambiguous search. Selection does not authorize writes or execution.
